# OPEC Monthly Oil Market Report, issue 2012-05, page 54. Only the product
# price table is reproduced, laid out as pdfplumber extracts it. OPEC is the
# copyright holder and the assessments are Argus's. The MOMR disclaimer permits
# the information it carries to be reproduced for educational and other non
# commercial purposes with OPEC acknowledged, which is what this parser fixture
# is. The rest of the page is not reproduced and no MOMR PDF is committed
# anywhere in this repository.
#
# ONE SUBSTITUTION, and no other change. Where the report writes the minus sign
# of its change column as an en dash, this file writes an ASCII hyphen, because
# SPEC.md section 0.1 forbids an en dash anywhere in the repository. The
# character stands for the same minus and no digit is touched.
#
# WHY THIS ISSUE IS HERE
# The same finding, second half. See the 2012-04 fixture. Note that the
# row LABELS are identical in the two issues, "Premium gasoline (unleaded 10
# ppm)", "Premium gasoline (unleaded 95)" and "Gasoil/Diesel (10 ppm)", which
# is what makes this a genuine disagreement between two vintages of one
# product rather than a respecification.
